notes: v651 - each pick now has a Practice buy button. It opens the app's usual buy window with the pick's numbers already filled in: a limit order at the buy-under price, with the take-profit and stop the rules chose. Everything after that is the normal flow on purpose - the position caps, the buy checklist, the stale-data warning and the confirm step all still apply, and NOTHING is placed until you press confirm yourself. You can change the amount or any of the prices before you do. If a pick names a share this device has not downloaded, it says so rather than opening a buy window it cannot price. The card now has three buttons: Practice buy, Open (the share console) and Report. Practice money only, and it still cannot touch a real broker. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
